notes.title: Tournament
notes.content:
[h3]⚽ GAME IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced Tournament Mode – Players can now create teams and register for tournaments. Team registration will start 10 minutes before the tournament begins. The number of teams is limited. Tournaments will be hosted on dedicated servers. Detailed information is available in the Tournament section
[*] Added a new difficulty level for bots
[*] Bots can now be included in custom multiplayer matches
[*] Added a new co-op challenge
[*] Added rewards to the Goalkeeper Challenge
[*] Added rare goal effects in the shop
[*] Added quantization to improve network traffic for the ball 
[*] Fixed numerous bugs
[/list]

notes.title: More Balls, More Fun!
notes.content:
[h3]⚽ GAME IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new types of matches for custom matches "basketball, volleyball, hockey"
[*] Custom matches no longer require a specific number of players to start a match. Custom matches will now have 8 slots, and to start a match, it's enough to be joined in a team
[*] Spectating has been added for custom matches. Spectating can be enabled in the lobby
[*] It is now possible to join the matchmaking team using a party ID
[/list]

notes.title: Controller Integration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/403add8eae0dd7095cf0eb0643f20145cb5bdc67.png[/img]

[h3]⚽ GAME IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🎮 Controller support has been added
[*] When setting up multiplayer and singleplayer matches, you can now choose which object you'd like to play with. Each object has its own unique physics
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/737570dfad5ea0feaed1612d007940565f0392a1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] For enhanced controller gameplay, a feature has been introduced to lock the character camera onto the ball. You can find this camera lock option in the settings. By default, the camera is unlocked, but you can toggle between these two options
[*] In singleplayer, players can view their trophies and identify which ones they are missing
[*] Automatic game progress and settings are now saved to the cloud
[*] New map [u]snowfield[/u]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/fa4e39cc8b08deeb165d985cfc2c06a02bf3d059.png[/img]

notes.title: Matchmaking
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/403add8eae0dd7095cf0eb0643f20145cb5bdc67.png[/img]

[h3]⚽ MATCHMAKING[/h3]
[list]
[*] Matchmaking uses the open skill algorithm to guarantee evenly matched opponents
[*] A ranking system has been added
[*] It's possible to create a team, invite friends, and search for a match based on location
[*] If your team doesn't have enough players, you'll be automatically merged with another team that has open slots.
[*] Matchmaking is divided into "prime" and "noprime"
[*] Everybody can host noprime matches
[*] The outcome of a noprime match is always submitted, regardless of whether a player finished the game or not
[*] Voice chat 
[/list]
[h3]⚽ GAME IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new currency has been added which can be earned by winning matches in matchmaking
[*] A new store has been added where you can purchase goal effects
[*] Goal effects can be set up in the customization
[*] With the integration of additional factors for precise network prediction, gameplay dynamics have evolved. The ball, which was previously pushed using a button, can now be pushed automatically without the need for manual input
[*] The ball's physics have been updated
[*] The force of your kick will also depend on your speed
[*] Stamina duration has been increased by 25%. While before you could run half a soccer field on full stamina, now you can traverse three-quarters of a soccer field
[/list]
[h3]⚽ CO-OP[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you advance in the co-op tournament, the map changes after every match
[*] The progress of the tournament will be saved
[/list]

notes.title: COOP & SOLO
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/403add8eae0dd7095cf0eb0643f20145cb5bdc67.png[/img]
[h3]⚽ COOP & SOLO[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new option is available, and that is the cooperative tournament. 16 teams compete in the tournament, and you advance through the knockout rounds to reach the final round. In the tournament lobby, you can choose to play alone in a "private lobby" or with friends in an "only friends" lobby, and then invite your friends to help you win the tournament, or you can choose "public" and anyone can join your lobby. You can find this tournament in the Coop & Solo section.
[/list]

[h3]⚽ SINGLEPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have expanded the training mode, so now you'll be able to play 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 matches with bots. Of course, the goalkeeper is still available, and you'll be able to add it if you want.
[/list]

[h3]⚽ CUSTOMIZATION[/h3]

[/list]

notes.title: Training & Spin kick
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43260450/403add8eae0dd7095cf0eb0643f20145cb5bdc67.png[/img]
[h3]⚽ SINGLEPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] Training is now available. You can choose a free kick or play a match with a bot. Custom match is limited to 1v1 yet, but you have an option to include a goalkeeper or not. Be kind to the bots, they are still in the progress.
[/list]
[h3]⚽ GAME MECHANIC[/h3]
[list]
[*] The ball used to move only in a straight direction up until now. We implemented an additional kick option that will make the ball spin and move in a curved direction. This type of kick has four levels of adjustment. 
[*] Spinning depends on the power of the kick. The more powerful the kick, the more curved the direction of the ball will be.
[/list]
[h3]⚽ MULTIPLAYER[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2x new maps
[*] map is smaller. Ideal for 1v1 battle
[*] map also brings some changes to the game. It is a hybrid between footballs
[/list]
[h3]⚽ NETWORK IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced latency and interpolation between client and server. However, server will always have an advantage over the client, but this will be solved later on by [b]dedicated servers[/b].
[/list]
[h3]⚽ CUSTOMIZATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] New outfits
[/list]
